clean_source_blocks.text: An emotional Teyana Taylor (left) received her Icon of the Year award from Janet Jackson US actress and musician Teyana Taylor was the big winner at the BET Awards in Los Angeles, and her tearful reaction to being presented with the Icon of the Year award by Janet Jackson provided one of the moments of the night. The 35-year-old, who made her Hollywood breakthrough in recent Oscar-winning film One Battle After Another, was sobbing as Jackson introduced her. "Oh my God... I'm gagging, they did not tell me Janet was coming," Taylor exclaimed as she joined her hero on stage. The multi-talented Taylor, who made her name when she choreographed a Beyoncé music video at the age of 15, also won the best actress, video director of the year and fashion vanguard awards at Sunday's ceremony.
Taylor had an emotional reaction to being presented with the Icon of the Year award by Janet Jackson.

Teyana Taylor will be honored for her cultural impact and creative achievements at the 2026 BET Awards The singer and actress recently earned her first Grammy nomination, Golden Globe win and an Academy Award nomination for her work The BET Awards will also honor Lauryn Hill with the Living Legend Icon Award Teyana Taylor will be recognized for being a "multi-hyphenate creative force." At the upcoming 2026 BET Awards, Taylor, 35, will receive the Icon of the Year award sponsored by Hyundai, BET announced on Tuesday, June 9. "Teyana Taylor is the embodiment of what it means to be an icon in this moment," Connie Orlando, the EVP of Specials, Music Programming & Music Strategy at BET, said in a press release.

In music, Taylor first broke out with her 2014 debut VII and most recently dropped a studio album called Escape Room in 2025. The record earned the singer-songwriter her first-ever Grammy nomination in the Best R&B Album category. Last year, she also earned her first-ever Golden Globe and was nominated for an Academy Award for her role in One Battle After Another. She also recently starred in Hulu's All's Fair and the Netflix film The Rip. The BET Awards, hosted by Druski, will air live on Sunday, June 28 from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Additional honorees, performers, presenters and special guests will be announced in the coming weeks. Earlier this month, BET also announced that Lauryn Hill would receive the inaugural Living Legend Icon Award sponsored by Sprite.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
An emotional Teyana Taylor (left) received her Icon of the Year award from Janet Jackson

US actress and musician Teyana Taylor was the big winner at the BET Awards in Los Angeles, and her tearful reaction to being presented with the Icon of the Year award by Janet Jackson provided one of the moments of the night.

The 35-year-old, who made her Hollywood breakthrough in recent Oscar-winning film One Battle After Another, was sobbing as Jackson introduced her.

"Oh my God... I'm gagging, they did not tell me Janet was coming," Taylor exclaimed as she joined her hero on stage.

The multi-talented Taylor, who made her name when she choreographed a Beyoncé music video at the age of 15, also won the best actress, video director of the year and fashion vanguard awards at Sunday's ceremony.

Taylor had to wipe the steam from her glasses during her acceptance speech

"I worked my ass off [for] 20 years for this," Taylor told the crowd, before taking her glasses off to clean the steam from the lenses.

"So I'm not accepting what I've earned with arrogance, I'm accepting what I've earned with gratitude.

"And this year alone I continue to give the world the artist, actress, director, choreographer, creative director, stylist, designer, writer, producer and chef! I graduated in September, y'all!"

The latter reference was about her training at the Auguste Escoffier School of Culinary Arts, which she juggled with her film and music careers.

This year has seen Taylor win a Golden Globe and receive an Oscar nomination for her role in One Battle After Another and a Grammy nomination for her album Escape Room.

She went on to tell the BET crowd that "this business can be very wicked [because] it teaches us to compete".

"I believe greatness isn't measured by how many people stand beneath you," she continued. "It's measured by how many people stand beside you because you're willing to reach back. That's the only legacy I care about."

Elsewhere at the ceremony, hip-hop duo Clipse won three prizes - album of the year, best group, and best collaboration for their song Chains & Whips with Kendrick Lamar.

British singer Olivia Dean was named best new artist after a year in which she has established herself as a bona fide global star.

Lauryn Hill received the inaugural living legend icon award, and made a surprise performance after a star-stdded tribute medley featuring Nas, SZA, Doechii, Lizzo, Doja Cat, Common and Queen Latifah.

payload.title: Teyana Taylor palkittiin BET Awards -gaalassa tunteikkaassa hetkessä
payload.summary: Teyana Taylor sai Icon of the Year -palkinnon Los Angelesissa järjestetyssä BET Awards -gaalassa. Janet Jacksonin yllätysesittely liikutti Taylorin kyyneliin, ja Taylor voitti illan aikana myös useita muita palkintoja.
payload.content:
Yhdysvaltalainen näyttelijä ja muusikko Teyana Taylor nousi BET Awards -gaalan suurimmaksi voittajaksi Los Angelesissa, kun hänelle luovutettiin Icon of the Year -palkinto Janet Jacksonin esitellessä hänet lavalle. Taylor liikuttui hetkestä näkyvästi, ja samassa seremoniassa hän voitti myös parhaan näyttelijän, vuoden video-ohjaajan ja Fashion Vanguard -palkinnot.

## Janet Jacksonin yllätys liikutti

35-vuotias Taylor purskahti kyyneliin, kun Jackson astui esiin luovuttamaan hänelle illan pääpalkintoa. Taylor sanoi lavalla yllättyneensä siitä, ettei hänelle ollut kerrottu Jacksonin saapumisesta. Hän kuvasi Jacksonia sankarikseen, ja hetki nousi lähdeaineiston mukaan yhdeksi illan huomatuimmista.

BET oli ennen gaalaa kertonut, että Taylor palkitaan kulttuurisesta vaikutuksestaan ja luovista saavutuksistaan. Kanavan edustaja Connie Orlando kuvasi tiedotteessa Tayloria tämän hetken ikonisuutta ilmentäväksi tekijäksi ja monialaiseksi luovaksi voimaksi. Taylorin ura on kulkenut musiikin, näyttelijäntyön, ohjauksen, muodin ja koreografian kautta. Hän teki itseään tunnetuksi jo 15-vuotiaana koreografina työskenneltyään Beyoncén musiikkivideolla.

## Ura on vahvistunut musiikissa ja elokuvissa

Taylorin musiikkiura lähti laajemmin liikkeelle vuoden 2014 esikoisalbumilla VII. Vuonna 2025 julkaistu Escape Room toi laulaja-lauluntekijälle hänen ensimmäisen Grammy-ehdokkuutensa parhaan R&B-albumin kategoriassa. Näyttelijänä hänen asemansa on vahvistunut elokuvassa One Battle After Another, josta lähdeaineisto kertoo hänen saaneen Golden Globe -voiton ja Oscar-ehdokkuuden. Hän on esiintynyt viime aikoina myös Hulu-sarjassa All's Fair ja Netflix-elokuvassa The Rip.

## Lauryn Hill huomioitiin myös

BET Awards -gaalassa huomioitiin myös Lauryn Hill, jolle ilmoitettiin annettavaksi ensimmäinen Living Legend Icon Award -palkinto. Gaalan juonsi Druski, ja tapahtuman paikaksi kerrottiin Peacock Theater Los Angelesissa. Ennen lähetystä BET ilmoitti, että lisää palkittavia, esiintyjiä, esittelijöitä ja erikoisvieraita julkistettaisiin myöhemmin.
